note: The units a trust bar value may carry after its number (lib/site-trust.mjs trustValue): a value is a number with an optional unit from this closed list; a word after the number outside it is dropped and reported back to Site Factory (site13 blind audit: "65 that", "55 custom", Site Factory's value pattern took the word after the number). Matched case-insensitively, a singular as its plural (piece as pieces); a multiplier (million, k) counts as a unit. A value that does not start with a number is left as it is.
